meta.title: The vendor re-bids after a rejection that allowed it
gaps: Perform the buyer-side bid rejection with “Allow seller to bid again” enabled before the rebid
Verify that the accepted quote is a distinct new bid specifically resulting from that rejection rather than a normal bid revision
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Perform the buyer-side bid rejection with “Allow seller to bid again” enabled before the rebid; Verify that the accepted quote is a distinct new bid specifically resulting from that rejection rather than a normal bid revision

steps.note: Open the prepared event with an existing bid, which is the closest available state for the post-rejection rebid scenario.
Continue in the Vendor A supplier session while leaving the buyer session available.
Open the event's pricing round after the buyer-side submission-time extension.
Submit Vendor A's quote of 95 as the rebid action.
Assert that the vendor portal accepted the submitted quote.
Return to the buyer console to inspect the resulting response.
Open the buyer's Responses view for the pricing stage.
Assert that the buyer sees Vendor A's direct response.
Open the buyer's Master QCS comparison grid.
Assert that the Master QCS shows the rebid price of 95.
Assert that the visible bid is ranked again in Master QCS.
